static_traits.name: Li Na
static_traits.social_status: 有几位朋友可倾诉，但尚not yet与他们讨论工作相关问题
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病，not yet接受过心理治疗；既往not yet出现类似问题

basic_info.main_problem: 今天在工作中失去一笔房屋销售后，我感到自己对老板not值得信任，这让我非常Anxiety与紧张。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些想法和感受正在影响我的工作表现并造成显著痛苦；我希望能够证明自己对老板是值得信任的，并减轻Anxiety。

special_situations.event: Lost a house sale at work (that day's viewing and negotiation failed, the client withdrew at the negotiation stage)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not成交，就说明我not可信、not胜任，并且会被老板negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我Rationalization、向老板寻求安慰与保证
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次失败证明我not可信，我会一直让老板失望

special_situations.event: After the incident the boss acted somewhat distant, although he had tried to comfort me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他have not像平时那样亲近或热情，那就意味着他对我失望、认为我not可信
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度谨慎、反复揣测他的看法、事事Self-doubt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他一定觉得我让他失望、他not再信任我

special_situations.event: Recalls a client withdrawing during the negotiation stage, causing the deal to fail
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 客户的退出表明我能力not足，这会引发职业危机与关系破裂
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度担忧与insomnia，试图通过自我说服来缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次失败会毁掉我的工作和关系

special_situations.event: 持续担心老板对自己可信度的评价
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我的价值与可信度取决于老板的认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断向老板寻求安慰与认可以确认自我价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只有老板认可我，我才值得信任

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and trusted by significant others (boss/partner), maintaining an intimate and stable relationship
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate、Being rejected与失去关系，同时担心职业前途受损
defense_goal: 通过Rationalization与过度Self-monitoring来降低被negate的风险
努力获得外部认可以维持安全感

object_relations.self_representation: 失败后感到自己是“not可信、not胜任”的下属/伴侣
object_relations.object_representation: 疏远且可能失望的权威者/伴侣

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing work failure or thinking about the boss's view of them
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为老板会因为一次失误negate自己，关系与职业都面临危险（带有Projection/读心的倾向）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Mainly gives explanations and reasons; tone is calm but avoids going into emotions; emphasizes external factors to reduce self-blame, avoiding facing inner shame and fear.

manifestations: Relationship with the boss strained by the incident, and he seems distant
对朋友感到尴尬而not yet寻求支持，保持沉默与自我隔离

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 在缺乏证据的情况下认定老板“觉得我not可信/让我失望”
把内在的not安与羞耻感投向他人的评价

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 事事谨慎、反复Self-doubt，担心任何举动会被老板负面评价
Persistent tension and excessive concern about others' opinions lead to impaired work performance

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Taking 'I must prove myself trustworthy' as a self-demand
Directly internalizing the boss's expectations as the standard for judging self-worth

positive_force: Shown as reliable and good at closing deals in past work (resource foundation)
Willing to communicate openly (plans to talk frankly with the boss)
具有一定的自我Reflection与改进动机
Having a certain social support network (a few friends to communicate with)
negative_force: Over-reliance on external recognition to judge self-worth (external validation)
灾难化、过度概括与读心等not良认知模式ReinforcementAnxiety
insomnia与持续担忧削弱工作专注与表现
工作与亲密关系边界not清导致压力聚焦于单一他者评价

target_behavior.behavior: 对老板是否信任自己的Persistent anxiety与过度担忧
antecedent: 当天丢失房屋销售后回想失败情境
老板表现出疏远或not如以往亲近
想到not yet来工作表现与老板评价
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing and overgeneralizing cognition about failure, and taking the boss's recognition as the main source of self-worth (external validation)
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定性与潜在批评，通过担忧与Self-monitoring试图获得控制感与安全感
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance、Sleep impaired、与老板Relationship tension、日常生活被Persistent anxiety打断

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与朋友讨论工作相关困扰
antecedent: 担心他人without法理解与评价自己
target_behavior.core_reason: 为了避免暴露脆弱与遭遇negate，选择保持沉默以短期减轻not适
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的负面评价或not被理解的风险
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient use of social support，Intensified sense of isolation，Anxiety维持与加剧
